Ravi (PM): Heads-up: want to finalize the design-partner pilot mechanics today. Focus areas: recruitment signal, expected feedback quality (not just speed), incentives (monetary vs product credits vs exec access), replacement flow, and legal checklist.

Mina (CS): For recruitment, prioritize customers with an active billing account + a production integration in the last 90 days. Also prefer a named product sponsor. Suggest candidate score: usage(45), recency(25), sponsor(20), compliance risk(10).

Kara (Eng): From eng ops: we can commit to 6h/week of SE time across the cohort. Recommend per-partner cap 2h/week. Also we need clear telemetry access rules and an opt-in debug level toggle for partners who agree to deeper traces.

Hiro (Design): Feedback quality: prefer recorded short sessions (15min) + a 4-question structured survey. Rate questions by impactability (can we act on it in 2 sprints?). Keep cognitive load low.

Theo (Legal): Legal: require a minimal pilot addendum for telemetry and IP. We can fast-track for small partners with standard MSA + addendum e-sign. No lengthy DPA changes.

Ravi (PM): Proposed program: 8 slots total (3 "deep" partners / 5 "light" partners). Deep = expected 2h/wk + 15m/week async notes + recorded sessions; Light = async forms only (1-2x month). Incentives: Deep = $800 credit + quarterly roadmap session with execs; Light = $200 credit + early-feature trial.

Mina (CS): Replacement rule: if partner misses two scheduled sessions without reschedule or fails to return 2 feedback forms in a 30-day window, flag and offer a single probationary reschedule. On second fail, release slot to waitlist. pilot-bot: implement automated probation notices.

pilot-bot: created probation workflow: send notice -> 72h accept window to reschedule -> if no action mark "released" and invite waitlist top candidate.

Kara (Eng): Operational note: enable high-detail traces only after addendum signed. KV warm-cache enable period: 7 days for deep partners, one-shot per partner. We should also tag metrics with partner_id to avoid mixing signals.

Hiro (Design): Measurement plan: two signals — structured feedback score (0..10) averaged across partners, and "actionability" flag on each item (yes/no). Also collect partner effort metric: reported hours/week.

Ravi (PM): Launch gate for each partner: smoke test green, addendum signed (if deep), kickoff recorded, baseline survey returned. Program success metrics overall: avg structured feedback >=6 and at least 3 actionable items identified in first 30 days.

Theo (Legal): Quick Q: any partners in regulated sectors (health/finance)? If yes we need privacy review and longer onboarding. Mark them high compliance risk in the spreadsheet.

Mina (CS): I'll add a filter to recruitment sheet to flag regulated sectors. Also want an intro email template. Draft: "Were inviting a small group to help shape X. Expected ~2h/week for deep partners. Incentive: early access + credit. Can you commit? Provide POC & timezone."

Kara (Eng): One more: define what counts as "actionable" — change we can implement in <=2 sprints that improves reliability or latency. Document examples in the playbook.

Ravi (PM): Agree. I'll draft the one-pager with the scoring rubric, probation rules, legal checklist, and metrics. Can everyone review by EOD?

Hiro (Design): Reviewed OK.

Theo (Legal): OK pending small edits.

Mina (CS): OK.

Kara (Eng): OK.

Ravi (PM): Thanks all. I'll schedule sends at 08:30 PT tomorrow and feed pilot-bot the invite list. Ping me if anything blocks overnight.
